plugin.name: DamTrack
plugin.author: Eric
plugin.purpose: Average melee and spell damage per round, by area, with separate 201 and 1-200 lists
plugin.description: DamTrack v1.0 Average melee and spell damage per round, per area, with level 201 and levels 1-200 kept as two separate lists. Type 'damtrack help' for commands.

trigger.match: ^Spectre of the Deep says 'Best to avoid his attention completely if you are able, lest you draw his ire\.'$
^Spectre of the Deep says, "A parting gift - at least until the brat gets up again\."$

muclient.script:
-- ============================================================================= -- SETTINGS -- ============================================================================= local ROUND_GAP = 1.0 -- seconds of silence between your damage lines that ends a round local SKILLS_COUNT_AS = "melee" -- kick/bash/backstab etc: "melee" or "spell" local SAVE_DELAY = 5 -- seconds after the first unsaved change before writing the file local MAX_RECORDS = 10 -- finished side tracks kept for "damtrack records" local COMBAT_STATE = 8 -- GMCP char.status state that means you are fighting local DPS_GRACE = 1.0 -- seconds after combat ends that damage still counts (killing blow)
local HIGH, LOW = "201", "1-200" -- the two separate lists local CHANNELS = { spo = true, gt = true, ft = true, clan = true, say = true } local CHANNEL_LIST = "spo, gt, ft, clan, say"
-- ============================================================================= -- STATE -- ============================================================================= local stats = { [HIGH] = {}, [LOW] = {} } -- stats[bracket][areakey] = {name, rounds, melee, spell} local level = 0 local track = nil -- running side track: { start = os.time(), stats = {...} } local records = {} -- finished side tracks, newest first: { start, stop, stats } local area_key, area_name = "unknown", "Unknown" local loaded_name = nil local round = nil local round_id = 0 local save_armed = false local dirty = false local debug_on = false local in_combat = false -- GMCP state == COMBAT_STATE local seg_start = 0 -- when the current stretch of combat time began local combat_end = -1000 -- when state 8 last ended local skd_run = false -- inside a Sea King's Dominion epic run: nothing is tracked
local function Now() if utils and utils.timer then return utils.timer() end return os.time() end
-- ============================================================================= -- COLOUR ECHO (@x099 @x045 @x048 @W) -- ============================================================================= local STD16 = { [0] = "#000000", "#800000", "#008000", "#808000", "#000080", "#800080", "#008080", "#C0C0C0", "#808080", "#FF0000", "#00FF00", "#FFFF00", "#0000FF", "#FF00FF", "#00FFFF", "#FFFFFF" } local CUBE = { 0, 95, 135, 175, 215, 255 }
local function XtermHex(n) if n > 255 then n = 255 end if n < 16 then return STD16[n] end if n >= 232 then local g = 8 + (n - 232) * 10 return string.format("#%02X%02X%02X", g, g, g) end n = n - 16 local r = CUBE[math.floor(n / 36) + 1] local g = CUBE[math.floor((n % 36) / 6) + 1] local b = CUBE[(n % 6) + 1] return string.format("#%02X%02X%02X", r, g, b) end
local function Echo(msg) local color = "#FFFFFF" local i = 1 while i <= #msg do if msg:sub(i, i) == "@" then local x = msg:match("^x(%d%d%d)", i + 1) if x then color = XtermHex(tonumber(x)); i = i + 5 elseif msg:sub(i + 1, i + 1) == "W" then color = "#FFFFFF"; i = i + 2 elseif msg:sub(i + 1, i + 1) == "@" then ColourTell(color, "", "@"); i = i + 2 else ColourTell(color, "", "@"); i = i + 1 end else local j = msg:find("@", i, true) or (#msg + 1) ColourTell(color, "", msg:sub(i, j - 1)) i = j end end Note("") end
local TAG = "@x099[@x045DamTrack@x099]@W "
-- ============================================================================= -- FORMATTING -- ============================================================================= local function Commas(n) local s = string.format("%.0f", n) local sign, int = s:match("^(-?)(%d+)$") if not int then return s end local r = int:reverse() r = r:gsub("(%d%d%d)", "%1,") r = r:reverse() r = r:gsub("^,", "") return sign .. r end
local function Title(s) return (s:gsub("(%a)([%w']*)", function(a, b) return a:upper() .. b end)) end
local function Round0(x) return math.floor(x + 0.5) end
-- avg melee, melee %, avg spell, spell % (nil when there is nothing to show) local function Parts(rec) if not rec or rec.rounds <= 0 then return nil end local tot = rec.melee + rec.spell if tot <= 0 then return nil end local pm = Round0(rec.melee / tot * 100) return Commas(Round0(rec.melee / rec.rounds)), pm, Commas(Round0(rec.spell / rec.rounds)), 100 - pm end
-- damage per second of combat time (state 8) as a number, or nil when there is none yet local function DpsValue(rec) if not rec or not rec.secs or rec.secs <= 0 then return nil end local d = rec.cm + rec.cs if d <= 0 then return nil end return d / rec.secs end
local function Dps(rec) local v = DpsValue(rec) if not v then return nil end return Commas(Round0(v)) end
-- "2h 15m", "3d 4h", "45m", "30s" local function Dur(s) s = math.max(0, math.floor(s)) local d = math.floor(s / 86400) local h = math.floor((s % 86400) / 3600) local m = math.floor((s % 3600) / 60) if d > 0 then return d .. "d " .. h .. "h" end if h > 0 then return h .. "h " .. m .. "m" end if m > 0 then return m .. "m" end return s .. "s" end
-- "Oct 05" (adds the year when it is not this year) local function DateStr(t) local s = os.date("%b %d", t) if os.date("%Y", t) ~= os.date("%Y") then s = s .. " " .. os.date("%Y", t) end return s end
-- coloured "12,665 avg melee (50%) 12,665 avg spell (50%) | 1,200 dps", or nil with no data local function InfoPart(rec) local am, pm, as, ps = Parts(rec) local dps = Dps(rec) if not am and not dps then return nil end local s = "" if am then s = "@x048" .. am .. " @Wavg melee @x099(@x048" .. pm .. "%@x099) @x048" .. as .. " @Wavg spell @x099(@x048" .. ps .. "%@x099)" end if dps then s = s .. (am and " @W| " or "") .. "@x048" .. dps .. " @Wdps" end return s end
-- Channel report with colour codes (Aardwolf channels expand @x codes for everyone). -- With a side track running the line gets a Track part (info | how long | since date) -- in front of the Lifetime part. local function ReportText(areaname, rec, trec) local head = "@x045DamTrack@x099: " if areaname then head = head .. "@x048" .. areaname .. "@x099: " end local life = InfoPart(rec) if not track then return head .. (life or "@Wno data") .. "@w" end return head .. "@x045Track@x099: " .. (InfoPart(trec) or "@Wno data") .. " @W| @x048" .. Dur(os.time() - track.start) .. " @Wsince @x048" .. DateStr(track.start) .. " @W| @x045Lifetime@x099: " .. (life or "@Wno data") .. "@w" end
-- ============================================================================= -- DAMAGE LINE PARSING (ported from the Cirrus approach) -- ============================================================================= local DAMAGE_VERBS = {} for _, v in ipairs({ "tickles","bruises","scratches","grazes","nicks","scars","hits","injures", "wounds","mauls","maims","mangles","mars","decimates","devastates","rends", "incinerates","lacerates","obliterates","massacres","disembowels","extirpates", "eradicates","dismembers","mutilates","blasts","demolishes","shreds","destroys", "pulverizes","vaporizes","atomizes","asphyxiates","ravages","fissures", "liquidates","evaporates","sunders","wastes","cremates","annihilates","implodes", "exterminates","shatters","slaughters","ruptures","nukes","glaciates","meteorites", "supernovas","damages","misses", "tears into", "does unspeakable things to","does unthinkable things to", "does unimaginable things to","does unbelievable things to", }) do DAMAGE_VERBS[v] = true end
-- Weapon-swing damage nouns: these are melee. local MELEE = {} for _, v in ipairs({ "acidic bite","digestion","slime","air","beating","blast","charge","crush","hit","pound", "punch","slap","smash","suction","thwack","chill","freezing bite","earth","shock", "shocking bite","friction","wrath","flame","flaming bite","divine power","light","magic", "mental energy","mind force","decaying touch","life drain","bite","chomp","peck","pierce", "scratch","stab","sting","thrust","chop","claw","cleave","grep","slash","slice","whip", "shadow","wail","water blast", }) do MELEE[v] = true end
-- Physical skills; they land in SKILLS_COUNT_AS. local SKILLS = {} for _, v in ipairs({ "bash","bodycheck","uppercut","kicked dirt","hammering blow","sap","kick","stunning blow", "stomp","gouge","mighty assault","scalp","spinning blade","backstab","spiralling force", "counter strike", }) do SKILLS[v] = true end
-- Not your own damage output local IGNORE = { ["group's combined attack"] = true }
local function StripDecor(text) local s = text:gsub("[%-%=<>%*%[%]:\\%+%.]+", " ") s = s:gsub("%s+", " ") s = s:gsub("^ ", "") s = s:gsub(" $", "") return s end
local function StripCombatLine(line) local s = line:gsub("^%*", "") s = s:gsub("^%[%d+%] ", "") s = s:gsub("^%b[] ", "") s = s:gsub("^%b[] ", "") s = s:gsub("^%b[] ", "") s = s:gsub("^%*", "") s = s:gsub("%s*%[%d+%]%*?$", "") return s end
-- The attack name is everything before the EARLIEST whole-word damage verb. local function ExtractAttackName(text) local lower = StripDecor(text):lower() local stripped = StripDecor(text) local best_pos, best_len = nil, 0 for verb in pairs(DAMAGE_VERBS) do local from = 1 while true do local s, e = lower:find(verb, from, true) if not s then break end local before_ok = s > 1 and not lower:sub(s - 1, s - 1):match("%a") local after_ok = not lower:sub(e + 1, e + 1):match("%a") if before_ok and after_ok then if not best_pos or s < best_pos or (s == best_pos and #verb > best_len) then best_pos, best_len = s, #verb end break end from = s + 1 end end if not best_pos then return nil end local before = stripped:sub(1, best_pos - 1):match("^(.-)%s+$") if before and #before > 0 then return before end return nil end
local function Classify(attack) local a = attack:lower() if IGNORE[a] then return nil end if MELEE[a] then return "melee" end if SKILLS[a] then return SKILLS_COUNT_AS end return "spell" end
-- ============================================================================= -- LEVEL / AREA (GMCP, handled directly like the other plugins) -- ============================================================================= local function CurrentBracket() if level <= 0 then return nil end return level >= 201 and HIGH or LOW end
local function NewStats() return { [HIGH] = {}, [LOW] = {} } end
local function RecIn(st, bracket, key, name) local areas = st[bracket] local rec = areas[key] if not rec then rec = { name = name, rounds = 0, melee = 0, spell = 0, secs = 0, cm = 0, cs = 0 } areas[key] = rec end return rec end
local function AreaRecord(bracket, key, name) return RecIn(stats, bracket, key, name) end
-- Every figure goes to lifetime, and also to the side track when one is running. local function Credit(bracket, key, name, rounds, melee, spell, secs, cm, cs) local function add(rec) rec.rounds = rec.rounds + rounds rec.melee = rec.melee + melee rec.spell = rec.spell + spell rec.secs = rec.secs + secs rec.cm = rec.cm + cm rec.cs = rec.cs + cs end add(RecIn(stats, bracket, key, name)) if track then add(RecIn(track.stats, bracket, key, name)) end end
local function MergeStats(dst, src) for b, areas in pairs(src) do if dst[b] then for k, r in pairs(areas) do local d = RecIn(dst, b, k, r.name) d.rounds = d.rounds + r.rounds d.melee = d.melee + r.melee d.spell = d.spell + r.spell d.secs = d.secs + r.secs d.cm = d.cm + r.cm d.cs = d.cs + r.cs end end end end
-- ============================================================================= -- PERSISTENCE (file on disk in GetInfo(66), one file per character) -- ============================================================================= local function DataPath(name) local safe = (name or "unknown"):gsub("[^%w_%-]", "_") return GetInfo(66) .. "DamTrack_" .. safe .. ".dat" end
local function WriteStats(f, prefix, st) for bracket, areas in pairs(st) do for key, rec in pairs(areas) do f:write(string.format("%s%s\t%s\t%s\t%.0f\t%.0f\t%.0f\t%.3f\t%.0f\t%.0f\n", prefix, bracket, key, rec.name, rec.rounds, rec.melee, rec.spell, rec.secs, rec.cm, rec.cs)) end end end
local function SaveData() if not dirty then return end local path = DataPath(loaded_name) local f = io.open(path, "w") if not f then Echo(TAG .. "@x048Could not write @W" .. path) return end f:write("DAMTRACK 2\n") WriteStats(f, "", stats) -- lifetime: first field is the level list if track then f:write(string.format("TRACK\t%.0f\n", track.start)) WriteStats(f, "TD\t", track.stats) end for i, r in ipairs(records) do f:write(string.format("REC\t%d\t%.0f\t%.0f\n", i, r.start, r.stop)) WriteStats(f, "RD\t" .. i .. "\t", r.stats) end f:close() dirty = false end
-- stats fields start at index i: bracket, key, name, rounds, melee, spell, secs, cm, cs local function AddFromFields(st, fields, i) local b, k, n = fields[i], fields[i + 1], fields[i + 2] local r, m, s = tonumber(fields[i + 3]), tonumber(fields[i + 4]), tonumber(fields[i + 5]) if not (b and st[b] and k and r and m and s) then return end local rec = RecIn(st, b, k, n or k) rec.rounds = rec.rounds + r rec.melee = rec.melee + m rec.spell = rec.spell + s rec.secs = rec.secs + (tonumber(fields[i + 6]) or 0) rec.cm = rec.cm + (tonumber(fields[i + 7]) or 0) rec.cs = rec.cs + (tonumber(fields[i + 8]) or 0) end
local function MergeFile(path) local f = io.open(path, "r") if not f then return end local ftrack_start, ftrack = nil, NewStats() local frecs = {} for ln in f:lines() do local fields = {} for fld in (ln .. "\t"):gmatch("([^\t]*)\t") do fields[#fields + 1] = fld end local tag = fields[1] if tag == "TRACK" then ftrack_start = tonumber(fields[2]) elseif tag == "TD" then AddFromFields(ftrack, fields, 2) elseif tag == "REC" then local idx = tonumber(fields[2]) if idx then frecs[idx] = frecs[idx] or { stats = NewStats() } frecs[idx].start = tonumber(fields[3]) frecs[idx].stop = tonumber(fields[4]) end elseif tag == "RD" then local idx = tonumber(fields[2]) if idx then frecs[idx] = frecs[idx] or { stats = NewStats() } AddFromFields(frecs[idx].stats, fields, 3) end else AddFromFields(stats, fields, 1) -- lifetime line (the header is skipped here) end end f:close() if ftrack_start and ftrack_start > 0 then if not track then track = { start = ftrack_start, stats = ftrack } else MergeStats(track.stats, ftrack) if ftrack_start < track.start then track.start = ftrack_start end end end if #records == 0 then local idxs = {} for idx in pairs(frecs) do idxs[#idxs + 1] = idx end table.sort(idxs) for _, idx in ipairs(idxs) do local r = frecs[idx] if r.start and r.stop and #records < MAX_RECORDS then records[#records + 1] = r end end end end
local function ArmSave() if save_armed then return end save_armed = true DoAfterSpecial(SAVE_DELAY, "DamTrackSave()", 12) end
-- Adds the combat time since the last flush to the area/level you are in now. -- Called whenever the context changes (area, level, leaving combat) and before reports/saves. local function FlushCombatTime() if not in_combat then return end local t = Now() local bracket = CurrentBracket() if bracket and t > seg_start and not skd_run then Credit(bracket, area_key, area_name, 0, 0, 0, t - seg_start, 0, 0) dirty = true ArmSave() end seg_start = t end
function DamTrackSave() save_armed = false FlushCombatTime() SaveData() end
-- ============================================================================= -- ROUND ENGINE -- A round = all your damage lines that arrive together. A gap of ROUND_GAP -- seconds ends it; a generation-counted timer closes the last one. -- Level bracket and area are taken when the round starts. -- ============================================================================= local function CloseRound() if not round then return end local r = round round = nil -- Only rounds with BOTH a melee line and a spell line count; anything else is skipped. if r.melee <= 0 or r.spell <= 0 then return end local bracket = r.bracket or CurrentBracket() if not bracket then return end -- level never became known: drop it Credit(bracket, r.key, r.name, 1, r.melee, r.spell, 0, 0, 0) dirty = true ArmSave() end
-- Begin/end of the SKD epic. Anything already counted stays; from the begin line -- until the end line no damage, rounds or combat time are recorded. function SkdRunBegin() if skd_run then return end CloseRound() FlushCombatTime() skd_run = true Echo(TAG .. "@WSea King's Dominion epic started - @x048not tracking @Wuntil it ends.") end
function SkdRunEnd() if not skd_run then return end skd_run = false seg_start = Now() -- the run's time is not combat time for the stats round = nil Echo(TAG .. "@WSea King's Dominion epic finished - @x048tracking again@W.") end
function DamTrackFinalize(id) if not round or round.id ~= id then return end local quiet = Now() - round.last if quiet >= ROUND_GAP then CloseRound() else DoAfterSpecial(ROUND_GAP - quiet + 0.1, "DamTrackFinalize(" .. id .. ")", 12) end end
local function AddDamage(kind, dmg) local t = Now() if round and (t - round.last) > ROUND_GAP then CloseRound() end if not round then round_id = round_id + 1 round = { id = round_id, melee = 0, spell = 0, last = t, bracket = CurrentBracket(), key = area_key, name = area_name } DoAfterSpecial(ROUND_GAP + 0.25, "DamTrackFinalize(" .. round_id .. ")", 12) end round[kind] = round[kind] + dmg round.last = t end
-- Damage for the per-second figure: only while GMCP says you are in combat -- (plus DPS_GRACE after it ends, so the killing blow is not lost). local function CountDps(kind, dmg) local bracket = CurrentBracket() if not bracket then return end if not in_combat and (Now() - combat_end) > DPS_GRACE then return end Credit(bracket, area_key, area_name, 0, 0, 0, 0, kind == "melee" and dmg or 0, kind == "melee" and 0 or dmg) dirty = true ArmSave() end
function OnSelfDamage(name, line, wildcards) if skd_run then return end local damage = tonumber(line:match("%[(%d+)%]%*?$")) or 0 if damage <= 0 then return end local clean = StripCombatLine(line) local lower = clean:lower() if lower:find("healed by ", 1, true) or lower:find(" heals ", 1, true) then return end local body = clean:match("^Your (.+)[%.!]$") if not body then return end local attack = ExtractAttackName(body) if not attack then return end local kind = Classify(attack) if not kind then return end AddDamage(kind, damage) CountDps(kind, damage) if debug_on then Echo(TAG .. "@x045" .. kind .. "@W: " .. attack .. " @x048" .. Commas(damage)) end end
-- ============================================================================= -- GMCP -- ============================================================================= local function OnCharName(nm) if loaded_name == nm then return end loaded_name = nm MergeFile(DataPath(nm)) dirty = true ArmSave() end
function OnPluginTelnetSubnegotiation(opt, data) if opt ~= 201 or type(data) ~= "string" then return end local msg, payload = data:match("^([%w%._]+)%s*(.*)$") if not msg then return end if msg == "char.status" or msg == "char.base" then local lv = tonumber(payload:match('"level"%s*:%s*"?(%d+)')) if lv and lv > 0 then if lv ~= level then FlushCombatTime() end -- close out time under the old level list level = lv end if msg == "char.status" then local st = tonumber(payload:match('"state"%s*:%s*"?(%d+)')) if st then if st == COMBAT_STATE then if not in_combat then in_combat = true; seg_start = Now() end elseif in_combat then FlushCombatTime() in_combat = false combat_end = Now() end end end if msg == "char.base" then local nm = payload:match('"name"%s*:%s*"([^"]+)"') if nm then OnCharName(nm) end end elseif msg == "room.info" then local z = payload:match('"zone"%s*:%s*"([^"]*)"') if z and z ~= "" then if z:lower() ~= area_key then FlushCombatTime() end -- close out time in the old area area_key, area_name = z:lower(), Title(z) end end end
-- ============================================================================= -- REPORTING -- ============================================================================= local function SumStats(st, bracket) local sum = { rounds = 0, melee = 0, spell = 0, secs = 0, cm = 0, cs = 0 } for _, rec in pairs(st[bracket]) do sum.rounds = sum.rounds + rec.rounds sum.melee = sum.melee + rec.melee sum.spell = sum.spell + rec.spell sum.secs = sum.secs + rec.secs sum.cm = sum.cm + rec.cm sum.cs = sum.cs + rec.cs end return sum end
local function GlobalRecord(bracket) return SumStats(stats, bracket) end
-- exact key first, then best prefix match, then best substring match local function FindIn(areas, kw) kw = kw:lower() if areas[kw] then return areas[kw] end local best, best_rank for key, rec in pairs(areas) do local rank if key:sub(1, #kw) == kw then rank = 2 elseif key:find(kw, 1, true) then rank = 3 end if rank and (not best or rank < best_rank or (rank == best_rank and rec.rounds > best.rounds)) then best, best_rank = rec, rank end end return best end
local function FindArea(bracket, kw) return FindIn(stats[bracket], kw) end
-- one coloured local line local function ShowLine(label, rec, is_current) local am, pm, as, ps = Parts(rec) local dps = Dps(rec) local line = TAG .. "@x045" .. label .. "@W: " if am then line = line .. "@x048" .. am .. " @Wavg melee @x099(@x048" .. pm .. "%@x099) @W| @x048" .. as .. " @Wavg spell @x099(@x048" .. ps .. "%@x099) @W| @x048" .. Commas(rec.rounds) .. " @Wrounds" end if dps then line = line .. (am and " @W| " or "") .. "@x048" .. dps .. " @Wdps" end if not am and not dps then line = line .. "@Wno data" end if is_current then line = line .. " @x099<- current" end Echo(line) end
local function ShowTrackHeader() Echo(TAG .. "@x045Track@W running @x048" .. Dur(os.time() - track.start) .. " @Wsince @x048" .. DateStr(track.start)) end
local function ShowGlobal() FlushCombatTime() local cur = CurrentBracket() local lp = "" if track then ShowTrackHeader() ShowLine("Track Level " .. HIGH, SumStats(track.stats, HIGH), cur == HIGH) ShowLine("Track Level " .. LOW, SumStats(track.stats, LOW), cur == LOW) lp = "Lifetime " end ShowLine(lp .. "Level " .. HIGH, GlobalRecord(HIGH), cur == HIGH) ShowLine(lp .. "Level " .. LOW, GlobalRecord(LOW), cur == LOW) end
local function ShowArea(kw) FlushCombatTime() local cur = CurrentBracket() if track then ShowTrackHeader() end for _, b in ipairs({ HIGH, LOW }) do local rec = FindArea(b, kw) local trec = track and FindIn(track.stats[b], kw) local nm = (rec and rec.name) or (trec and trec.name) or Title(kw) if track then ShowLine("Track Level " .. b .. " " .. nm, trec, cur == b) end ShowLine((track and "Lifetime " or "") .. "Level " .. b .. " " .. nm, rec, cur == b) end end
local function ShowHelp() Echo(TAG .. "@x048Average damage per round, melee vs spell") Echo("@x045damtrack @W- show averages and damage per second for both level lists") Echo("@x045damtrack @x048<chan> @W- report global numbers (@x048" .. CHANNEL_LIST .. "@W)") Echo("@x045damtrackarea @x048<area> @W- show one area (matches the start of the area keyword)") Echo("@x045damtrackarea @x048<area> <chan> @W- report that area only; no data shows as no data") Echo("@x045damtrack @x048<area> [chan] @W- same as damtrackarea") Echo("@x045damtrack areas @W- areas with dps data, lowest dps to highest, with avg melee/spell and %") Echo("@x045damtrack start @W- begin a fresh side track; lifetime keeps tallying and reports show both") Echo("@x045damtrack stop @W- end the side track and save it (last " .. MAX_RECORDS .. " are kept)") Echo("@x045damtrack records @W- show the saved side tracks, newest first") Echo("@x099Damage per second @Wcounts only time spent in combat (GMCP state @x048" .. COMBAT_STATE .. "@W).") Echo("@x099Sea King's Dominion epic@W: tracking pauses from the Spectre's first line to its parting line. @x045damtrack skd @Wtoggles that by hand.") Echo("@x045damtrack debug @W- toggle echo of each tracked hit and how it was classed") Echo("@x045damtrack reset confirm @W- wipe lifetime data (side tracks and saved records are kept)") Echo("@x099Level @x048201 @Wand @x048" .. LOW .. " @Ware tracked as two separate lists; reports use the one matching your current level.") end
local function NoLevel() Echo(TAG .. "@WYour level has not been detected yet (it arrives over GMCP). Fight or move and try again.") end
-- "<area> [chan]": local view without a channel, report with one local function AreaCommand(arg) local kw, chan = arg:match("^(%S+)%s*(%S*)$") if not kw or CHANNELS[kw] then Echo(TAG .. "@WUsage: @x045damtrackarea @x048<area> [chan]@W, e.g. @x045damtrackarea gelidus gt") return end if chan == "" then ShowArea(kw) return end if not CHANNELS[chan] then Echo(TAG .. "@x048" .. chan .. " @Wis not a channel here (@x048" .. CHANNEL_LIST .. "@W).") return end local bracket = CurrentBracket() if not bracket then NoLevel() return end FlushCombatTime() local rec = FindArea(bracket, kw) local trec = track and FindIn(track.stats[bracket], kw) local nm = (rec and rec.name) or (trec and trec.name) or Title(kw) Execute(chan .. " " .. ReportText(nm, rec, trec)) end
-- areas with data, lowest dps first so the best ones end up nearest your prompt local function ShowAreas() FlushCombatTime() local any = false for _, b in ipairs({ HIGH, LOW }) do local list = {} for key, rec in pairs(stats[b]) do local v = DpsValue(rec) if v then list[#list + 1] = { key = key, dps = v, rec = rec } end -- areas with no dps yet are left out end if #list > 0 then any = true table.sort(list, function(a, c) if a.dps ~= c.dps then return a.dps < c.dps end return a.key < c.key end) Echo(TAG .. "@x045Level " .. b .. "@W areas, lowest to highest dps:") for _, e in ipairs(list) do local line = " @x048" .. e.key .. "@W: @x099" .. Commas(Round0(e.dps)) .. " @Wdps" local am, pm, as, ps = Parts(e.rec) if am then line = line .. " @W| @x099" .. am .. " @Wavg melee (@x099" .. pm .. "%@W) @x099" .. as .. " @Wavg spell (@x099" .. ps .. "%@W)" end Echo(line) end end end if not any then Echo(TAG .. "@WNo areas with dps data yet.") end end
local function TrackStart() if track then Echo(TAG .. "@WA track is already running (@x048" .. Dur(os.time() - track.start) .. " @Wsince @x048" .. DateStr(track.start) .. "@W). Use @x045damtrack stop @Wfirst.") return end CloseRound() -- anything before now belongs to lifetime only FlushCombatTime() track = { start = os.time(), stats = NewStats() } dirty = true SaveData() Echo(TAG .. "@WTrack started. Lifetime keeps tallying; reports now show both.") end
local function TrackStop() if not track then Echo(TAG .. "@WNo track is running. Use @x045damtrack start@W.") return end CloseRound() FlushCombatTime() local rec = { start = track.start, stop = os.time(), stats = track.stats } table.insert(records, 1, rec) while #records > MAX_RECORDS do table.remove(records) end track = nil dirty = true SaveData() Echo(TAG .. "@WTrack stopped after @x048" .. Dur(rec.stop - rec.start) .. " @W(since @x048" .. DateStr(rec.start) .. "@W). Saved as @x048#1@W, see @x045damtrack records@W.") for _, b in ipairs({ HIGH, LOW }) do local s = SumStats(rec.stats, b) if Parts(s) or Dps(s) then ShowLine("Track Level " .. b, s, false) end end end
local function ShowRecords() if #records == 0 then Echo(TAG .. "@WNo saved tracks yet. @x045damtrack start @Wthen @x045damtrack stop @Wto make one.") return end Echo(TAG .. "@x045Saved tracks@W, newest first (last @x048" .. MAX_RECORDS .. "@W kept):") for i, r in ipairs(records) do Echo("@x099#@x048" .. i .. "@W: @x045" .. DateStr(r.start) .. " @Wto @x045" .. DateStr(r.stop) .. " @W(@x048" .. Dur(r.stop - r.start) .. "@W)") local shown = false for _, b in ipairs({ HIGH, LOW }) do local s = SumStats(r.stats, b) if Parts(s) or Dps(s) then ShowLine(" Level " .. b, s, false); shown = true end end if not shown then Echo(" @Wno data") end end end
function CmdDamTrack(name, line, wildcards) local arg = (wildcards[1] or ""):lower() if arg == "" then ShowGlobal() elseif arg == "help" or arg == "?" then ShowHelp() elseif arg == "debug" then debug_on = not debug_on Echo(TAG .. "@WHit debug is now @x048" .. (debug_on and "on" or "off")) elseif arg == "areas" then ShowAreas() elseif arg == "start" then TrackStart() elseif arg == "stop" then TrackStop() elseif arg == "records" then ShowRecords() elseif arg == "skd" then -- manual override if a begin/end line was missed (reload mid-run, death, etc.) if skd_run then SkdRunEnd() else SkdRunBegin() end elseif arg == "reset" then Echo(TAG .. "@WThis erases your lifetime data (side tracks are kept). Type @x045damtrack reset confirm @Wto go ahead.") elseif arg == "reset confirm" then stats = { [HIGH] = {}, [LOW] = {} } round = nil dirty = true SaveData() Echo(TAG .. "@WLifetime data cleared.") elseif CHANNELS[arg] then local bracket = CurrentBracket() if not bracket then NoLevel() return end FlushCombatTime() Execute(arg .. " " .. ReportText(nil, GlobalRecord(bracket), track and SumStats(track.stats, bracket))) else -- anything else is an area keyword: "damtrack blackclaw" or "damtrack blackclaw spo" AreaCommand(arg) end end
function CmdDamTrackArea(name, line, wildcards) AreaCommand((wildcards[1] or ""):lower()) end
-- ============================================================================= -- LIFECYCLE -- ============================================================================= function OnPluginInstall() Echo(TAG .. "@Wloaded. Type @x045damtrack help @Wfor commands.") -- Installed mid-session: ask Aardwolf to resend char info so name and level arrive. if IsConnected() then SendNoEcho("protocol gmcp sendchar") end end
function OnPluginSaveState() CloseRound() FlushCombatTime() SaveData() end
function OnPluginClose() CloseRound() FlushCombatTime() SaveData() end
function OnPluginDisconnect() CloseRound() FlushCombatTime() in_combat, combat_end, skd_run = false, -1000, false SaveData() stats = { [HIGH] = {}, [LOW] = {} } track, records = nil, {} loaded_name, level = nil, 0 area_key, area_name = "unknown", "Unknown" dirty = false end
